notes.notes: [h1]Welcome to the Refinement update![/h1][p]This update is technically the first half of the quote "bigger release on its way", with refinements, new towers and visual improvements to boot. Coming updates will have larger adjustments.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Content:[/h2][p][/p][h3]Tower Tech Tree[/h3][p]Added a Tower Tech Tree, now you have to research towers in proper order![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/c4f559cfc77b82d4e538b45307e6c1c5463c1b5e.png"][/img][/p][p]Pressing the "Tower Tree" button on the top of the page returns you to the regular Tower Select mode. [/p][p][/p][p]( Small sneak peek of some of the new towers ;) )[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/81de126a8edce1614981cf863980cd7ba440d6ba.png"][/img][/h3][h3]Zombie "Info" panel[/h3][p]Now also with a much better info system for zombies:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/77250c1b1d7d698b085db74eb71fecc37fc3fb98.png"][/img][/p][p]In this example you can see what the "zombie" is strong against (taking 67% less damage from bullets) and weak against (taking 50% more damage from explosions).[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog:[/h2][p]Additions:[/p][p]*  Big Addition, Hidden enemies![/p][p][/p][p]Added Shotgunner[/p][p]Added Flamethrower[/p][p]Added Dinghy[/p][p][/p][p]Added Fire resistance[/p][p]Added display for all resistances[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Adjustments:[/p][p]Adjusted: Upgrade menu, added not-so-descriptive descriptions for each upgrade.[/p][p]Adjusted: Certain towers to have hidden detection, along with their stats adjusted to compensate for having hidden detection.[/p][p]Adjusted: The first two (, and for now only) difficulties have been nerfed in difficulty, giving the player more cash per wave.[/p][p][/p][p]Nerf: Overall weakening and rebalancing of Gunner.[/p][p]Nerf: Overall weakening and rebalancing of Laser unit.[/p][p]Nerf: Overall weakening and rebalancing of Commando.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading :D[/p]

notes.title: The "In Between" Update!!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the "In Between" Update!![/h1]

This is a small update leading up to the bigger release on its way, currently development is slowing down for a couple of weeks, expected to pick back up at the end of may leading to a big release somewhere next month!

[h3]New Content!![/h3]
Enjoy the two new "Heavy" towers added to the game, the [b]Commando[/b] and [b]Tanker[/b], as well as the new (sort of) scenic [b]day and night cycle[/b]![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602158/dbd47474e6ee65b6471d8a2b190c72e5dd18acdd.png[/img]
Sneak peek screenshot!

[h3]Changelogs:[/h3]
[b]Additions / Tweaks:[/b]
Added 2 towers
Added day and night cycle
Reworked shadows to be more "pretty" (from blob to "drop" shadows)

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
Nerf: Snipers "Railgun" upgrade now deals less damage (800 -> 600)
Nerf: Gunners "Better Rifle" upgrade now costs more (1050 -> 1250)

Gameplay change: Wave 0 now has a skip timer set to 5 seconds on every difficulty, meaning you can skip almost instantly on starting a new game.
